[!compiler:gc] skip

env GO111MODULE=off
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

go build -o $WORK/hello.exe -debug-actiongraph=$WORK/graph1.json hello.go
grep '"Mode":[[:space:]]*"link"' $WORK/graph1.json
grep '"ActionIDInputs":[[:space:]]*"link\\n' $WORK/graph1.json
grep 'packagemain ' $WORK/graph1.json
grep '"CacheResult":[[:space:]]*"miss"' $WORK/graph1.json

go build -o $WORK/hello.exe -debug-actiongraph=$WORK/graph2.json hello.go
grep '"CacheResult":[[:space:]]*"target-buildid"' $WORK/graph2.json
grep '"CacheResult":[[:space:]]*"main-target-link"' $WORK/graph2.json

-- hello.go --
package main

func main() {}
